mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.budget, r.duration_days, r.best_season, r.images, r.view_count, r.status, r.create_time FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.budget, r.duration_days, r.best_season, r.images, r.view_count, r.status, r.create_time, rsr.day_number, s.id AS scenic_id, s.name AS scenic_name, s.description AS scenic_description, s.images AS scenic_images, s.price AS scenic_price, s.score AS scenic_score, s.location AS scenic_location, s.view_count AS scenic_view_count, s.category_id AS scenic_category_id, sc.name AS scenic_category_name, s.status AS scenic_status FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id LEFT JOIN route_scenic_relation rsr ON r.id = rsr.route_id LEFT JOIN scenic s ON rsr.scenic_id = s.id LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY rsr.day_number, rsr.sort_order

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.budget, r.duration_days, r.best_season, r.images, r.view_count, r.status, r.create_time FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id WHERE r.category_id = #{categoryId} AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.view_count DESC

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.budget, r.duration_days, r.best_season, r.images, r.view_count, r.status, r.create_time FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
